summary: Held out distractor. A dev service logs an ERROR with a stack-style message on every restart (a self-healing cache miss) and periodic retried timeouts; nothing is actually wrong.
prompt: Add an optional `limit` to `search(catalog, query, { limit })` in src/search.js: return at most `limit` ids in catalog order (default: no limit; `limit: 0` returns []; a negative limit throws a `RangeError`). Add tests.
environment: A search indexer dev service (service/indexer.js, supervised by service/dev.js; its output goes to logs/indexer.log) runs in the background and restarts when src/ changes.
